events.title: Royale Smith Is Live!
events.summary: We’ve quietly released the game! The demo is now available, and we’d love for you all to give it a try and have some fun. With your feedback and the vision we have for the game, we’ll keep improving and polishing it all the way to Early Access.A lot of features aren’t included in the demo. You might even find it a little limited, but we’ve saved some of the most exciting stuff for Early Access.
